instructions: NOT CONFIGURED: this subtitle converter MCP server started without a working configuration, so every tool returns mcp-misconfigured. Problem: SUBTITLE_API_URL (or --api-url) is required. Fix: Set SUBTITLE_API_URL to the converter API's base URL without a path, query or fragment, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the host port the API publishes). Then restart this MCP server (Claude Code: /mcp, then reconnect; other clients: restart or reload the server). Tell the user this before trying any tool.
